caption: The drawing depicts three objects on a plain, beige background. The central object is a short-sleeved, knee-length dress rendered in pink tones with a fitted bodice, gathered waist, and a full skirt. The dress features decorative white lace and embroidery along the neckline, sleeves, waistband, and hem. To the upper right, there is a black and white line drawing of the same dress shown from the back, highlighting the lace details, waistband, skirt hem, and a ribbon tied at the waist. At the bottom left, there is a separate illustration of a curved, pink collar with matching white lace and embroidery that corresponds to the neckline of the dress. The composition arranges the colored dress in the center, the black and white back view at the top right, and the standalone collar at the lower left, all on an unadorned background.
title: Child's Dress
